schemathesis_no_target: No target is configured: set tools.<instance>.target to the base URL of a running local or disposable environment. Without a target the API contract tests cannot run, so the stage is blocked, never passed.
schemathesis_missing: Schemathesis is not installed ({detail}). Run jgates doctor --fix (pip install into the JGates environment), or install it with pip install schemathesis and point JGATES_SCHEMATHESIS to its st executable. JGates never installs it during a run. See https://schemathesis.readthedocs.io/en/stable/.
schemathesis_probe_failed: Schemathesis at {path} did not answer --version. Reinstall it (jgates doctor --fix or pip install schemathesis).
schemathesis_no_spec: No OpenAPI specification was found (openapi.yaml, openapi.json, swagger.* ...). Set tools.<instance>.spec to its path.
schemathesis_auth_missing: The authentication of the instance reads the environment variable {env}, which is not set. Set it for the run; JGates never tests without the declared authentication.
schemathesis_timeout: Schemathesis exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended; its partial reports were kept.
schemathesis_cancelled: The run was cancelled; Schemathesis was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
schemathesis_invalid_output: The Schemathesis reports could not be interpreted: {detail}
schemathesis_run_errors: Schemathesis did not exercise {target} as planned: {detail}
schemathesis_no_invocation: The plan has no Schemathesis invocation for the instance {tool}.
schemathesis_reason_completed: Schemathesis {version}: {count} contract violation(s) in {tested} operation(s) of {target}
schemathesis_condition_target: Sends generated requests, valid and invalid, to {target}.
schemathesis_condition_no_target: No target is configured: the stage is blocked until tools.<instance>.target is set.
schemathesis_condition_bounds: Seed {seed}, at most {examples} examples per operation, {request} s per request, {timeout} s for the stage.
schemathesis_condition_auth: Authentication: the header {header} with the value of the environment variable {env} (never written in the plan).
schemathesis_limitation_target: Schemathesis: runs only against the configured running target (use a local or disposable environment, never production); without a target the stage is blocked, never passed.
schemathesis_setting_target: The target of the instance {tool} is {value}; use an http:// or https:// base URL without credentials, query or fragment.
schemathesis_setting_spec: The spec of the instance {tool} is {value}; use a relative path inside the project.
schemathesis_setting_auth: The auth of the instance {tool} must be { header: <HTTP header name>, valueEnv: <environment variable name> }; the secret itself is never written in the configuration.
schemathesis_setting_number: The {key} of the instance {tool} is {value}; use an integer from {min} to {max}.
schemathesis_setting_checks: The checks of the instance {tool} must be a non-empty list of: {allowed}.
schemathesis_fix: Run jgates doctor --fix to install Schemathesis into the JGates environment (pip), or install it yourself (pip install schemathesis) and set JGATES_SCHEMATHESIS to its st executable, then run doctor again.
